rule.text: A district appears when a city's workforce share in its sector is at least 1.25× the Central Asian average (location quotient ≥ 1.25), ranked by workers above the regional norm (up to 5 per city).

catalog.name: Campus

catalog.name: Industrial zone

catalog.name: Caspian port
catalog.description: Caspian Sea maritime ports and trans-Caspian ferry terminals.

catalog.name: Silk Road quarter
catalog.description: Historic Silk Road architecture, crafts, museums and hospitality.

catalog.name: Government plaza
catalog.description: National ministries, parliament and regional administration.

catalog.name: Hydro & power
catalog.description: Major hydroelectric cascades, thermal power stations and irrigation hubs.
